UP GNM Entrance Exam UPGET Result 2026 - Complete Details

UP GNM Entrance Exam UPGET Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. The last date to apply is 26/05/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 29/04/2026
  • Last Date : 26/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 26/05/2026
  • Correction Date : 19-26 May 2026
  • Exam City Released Date : 09/06/2026
  • Admit Card Date : 13/06/2026
  • Exam Date : 16/06/2026
  • Result Declare Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • Download Exam City Details : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 29/04/2026
  • Last Date : 26/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 26/05/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 2000/-

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
